provenance.note: Reactor containment building, identified in OSM by power=generator, generator:source=nuclear, generator:output:electricity=944 MW, manufacturer:type consistent with a M310 PWR. Assignment to the Daya Bay NIM paper's reactor-core label (D1/D2/L1/L2/L3/L4, Table 2) is inferred from which self-consistent multilateration fit of the three experimental halls' surveyed AD-to-core baselines gives the smallest residual against this building's OSM position (see geometry:daya-bay-eh1-hall method and the worklog); the paper itself does not name which physical unit is D1 vs D2 (or L1 vs L2, L3 vs L4), so this specific half of the label pair is not independently sourced, only the pair (this plant's two units) is.

features.method: Nonlinear least-squares multilateration (scipy.optimize.least_squares on raw Euclidean centre-to-centre distance residuals, local equirectangular projection) of this hall's position from the six Daya Bay/Ling Ao/Ling Ao-II reactor-core buildings (geometry:daya-bay-core-d1/d2, geometry:lingao-core-l1/l2, geometry:lingao-ii-core-l3/l4; accuracy_m 8 each), using the mean of this hall's antineutrino-detector(AD)-to-core-centre baselines from arXiv:1508.03943 Table 2 (survey uncertainty stated as < 18 mm) as the target distance to each core. Fit residual (measured centre-to-centre distance vs. the Table-2 mean) is under 5 m on every one of the six cores (max 0.4% of the baseline); accuracy_m is set well above that residual to also cover the buildings' own ~8 m footprint accuracy and the approximation of using each hall's own AD-mean baseline rather than a single physically-located point within the hall.
